abstract_en: Circulating tumor cells (CTCs) are cancer cells found in the bloodstream that serve as biomarkers for early cancer detection, prognostication, and disease monitoring. However, CTC detection remains challenging due to low cell abundance and heterogeneity. Digital holographic microscopy (DHM) offers a promising, label-free method for high-throughput CTC identification by capturing superior morphological information compared to traditional imaging methods, while remaining compatible with in-flow data acquisition. We present a streamlined DHM-based system that integrates microfluidic enrichment with deep learning-driven image analysis, supplemented by immunofluorescent profiling, to improve sensitivity and specificity of CTC enumeration. Specifically, our platform combines inertial microfluidic preprocessing with dual-modality imaging, integrating holography with fluorescence sensing of up to two markers. A deep learning model, trained on a diverse set of healthy blood samples and cancer cell lines, and executed in real-time, provides a morphological confidence on a cell-by-cell basis that may then be combined with immunofluorescence criteria for enumeration. In a pilot study, we demonstrate higher CTC counts in patients with late-stage prostate cancer ( n = 13) compared to healthy controls ( n = 8), with a patient-level false positive rate of 1 cell/mL. Notably, nearly two-thirds of identified CTCs were EpCAM-negative but PSMA positive (a prostate specific epithelial marker), suggesting that traditional use of EpCAM as an epithelial marker for CTCs may lead to false negatives. These findings highlight the potential of DHM for applications including but not limited to screening, diagnostics, and precision oncology.
abstract_zh: 构建无标记循环肿瘤细胞（CTC）检测系统：锯齿形惯性微流控芯片富集CTC（去除>99.999%红细胞、约99.6%白细胞，保留95%加标癌细胞，富集>100倍），数字全息显微镜（DHM）在流中采集双模态（全息+荧光）图像，深度学习实时生成CTC概率热图，结合免疫荧光谱提高敏感度与特异性。
background_zh: CTCs是早期癌症检测、预后与监测的生物标志物，但丰度极低、异质性强，现有检测方法灵敏性/特异性不足。
problem_zh: 如何在血流中高通量、无标记地检测并表征稀有CTC，同时保持临床可接受的特异性？
data_zh: 癌患者全血样本；微流控富集后DHM全息图像+荧光图像；深度学习用标注的癌/健康细胞图像训练。
task_zh: 微流控富集→在流全息成像→深度学习实时分类检测CTC→荧光谱补充验证。
method_zh: 锯齿惯性芯片去背景（>100倍富集）；405 nm脉冲激光拍摄全息图，编码形态信息；定制深度神经网络实时输出CTC空间概率热图；免疫荧光谱对检出细胞进行确认/表征。
results_zh: 实现癌患者样本中CTC的高灵敏、高特异检测：富集端去除>99.999% RBC、约99.6% WBC、保留95%加标癌细胞；深度学习在流而非离线处理全息图，支持实时检测。
innovation_zh: 惯性微流控富集 + DHM在流全息成像 + 深度学习实时概率热图 + 免疫荧光谱的“双模态”CTC检测流水线。
limitation_zh: 依赖定制芯片与临床样本验证规模；深度学习性能受标注数据与血液背景影响；荧光谱仅作补充仍需染色。
paradigm_zh: 富集-成像-深度学习的“管线式”范式：物理富集降维度、无标记全息成像保信息、深度学习做判别、荧光做确证。
framework_zh: 全血预处理→惯性富集→水动力学聚焦→双模态成像（全息+荧光）→深度学习概率热图→CTC判定与计数。
framework_steps: 数据与预处理：全血样本、富集参数、标注全息图像
模型设计：定制CNN输出空间热图，融合荧光特征
训练策略：癌/健康细胞标注训练与临床样本验证
评估与解读：灵敏度、特异性、富集倍数与计数一致性
scheme_zh: Scheme展示从全血→锯齿芯片富集→流动全息成像→DL概率热图→荧光确证的流水线。
lessons_zh: 把“物理富集+无标记成像+深度学习”组合成管线，是解决稀有细胞检测灵敏度的关键；实时性依赖芯片与算法的端到端匹配。
title_en: Circulating tumor cell detection in cancer patients using in-flow deep learning holography
title_zh: 流动中深度学习全息成像检测癌症患者循环肿瘤细胞
